```plato

//==
// # Slabs

// The closed 2D region between two parallel lines: the points p whose signed
// distance Dot(Normal, p) lies within Interval. Interval runs from the lower to
// the upper signed distance.
type Slab2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IConvexShape, IConnected, IContainsPoint2D
{
    Normal: Direction2D;
    Interval: NumberInterval;
}
```
